title: Special Height and Setback Regulations
previewText: The height and setback regulations of the underlying district shall apply, except as modified in this Section, inclusive. Furthermore, for any zoning lot located adjacent to the High Line, the provisions of Section 98-50, inclusive, shall also apply. All heights shall be measured from the base plane, unless otherwise specified.
